systems.system: biometric enrolment under the Réforme de la gestion de l'état civil et de l'identité (RECI)
systems.owner: ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation (MID), supported by the World Bank through PRODIGY
systems.tiers: progressive integration of citizens into a national database; 2,500 enrolment kits, mobile and ultra-mobile devices among them, to be deployed nationally; 70 districts trained by 22 January 2026

note: Titled as modernisation of the état civil but describes identity enrolment only; no civil registration office system is described.
